summary: Today brings a mixed news cycle driven by strict consumer court procedural rulings alongside major financial updates across Indian retail and corporate sectors. Highlights include consumer forum compliance limits for insurers alongside major cap-ex and growth targets from Reliance, Titan, Rentomojo, and Lenskart.

bullets.text: NCDRC ruled that an insurer's internal administrative delays and coordination issues do not constitute valid grounds for condoning delayed legal filings.
Reliance planned a ₹43,000 crore underground coal gasification project in Eluru, Andhra Pradesh, significantly expanding its energy infrastructure footprint.
Rentomojo reported a 63% drop in Q2 net profit due to tax effects, despite revenue increasing 53.1% to ₹143.79 crore.
Titan issued an 11% margin guidance for its jewellery division, anticipating that stabilized gold prices will restore consumer demand.
Lenskart set a target to expand its annual eyewear volume in India from 32 million to 100 million units.
